title: Navigating Change: The Reconciliation Act's Role in Reshaping Energy Policy and Utility Strategies
content: The enactment of “An Act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to Title II of H. Con. Res. 14,” otherwise known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (also known the Reconciliation Act, or the Act), on July 4, 2025, marks a significant turning point in US energy policy. The Act fundamentally alters the framework established by the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) of 2022, by scaling back clean energy incentives, streamlining permitting processes, and prioritizing nuclear energy. It also introduces sweeping changes with long-lasting impacts on the energy and utility sectors. These policy shifts require a reevaluation of how electricity is generated, how transmission and distribution (T&D) infrastructure is developed, and how technology is to be incentivized amid an increasingly complex regulatory and economic landscape.
